fusions.name: Flushing Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks off a target as you spring away, dealing 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Last Bound
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% health up to 6 tiles away, dealing 20 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Spring Clear
fusions.desc: Bursts 5 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Skittish Grace
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
